Thin gRPC transport of ChatService: reads caller tenant and user from metadata, converts proto to domain, calls one use case per handler and maps errors to gRPC codes. Open it to add or change an RPC handler or its request validation.

Chat wiring and commands: Main dispatches serve, probe, resync, recount and indexes; builds Mongo, NATS and Redis clients, bootstraps collections and streams, wires every component and the Mention App, runs them under a supervisor with ordered shutdown, and exports metrics and probes.

Loads and validates every chat node env var into Config, reusing each component's Validate, and derives the shutdown StopPlan and redacted log fields. Open it when adding a config var (then update docs/apps/chat.md).

Client id and request id dedupe on the dedupe Redis: batched Lua Reserve, Commit and Abort per shard with degraded mode through redisguard, plus Requests for idempotent AddMembers and CreateRoom by request_id. Open it for send retries or request dedupe.
Chat-specific helpers shared by event consumers: a bounded room identity cache, the message key builder and error classifiers that decide when a record is dropped instead of retried.

Projections consumer on CHATIM_EVT: one durable pull consumer, led by the slot 0 owner, decodes events and feeds the room_activity and reply_index handlers in batches with ack, Nak and drop settling. Open it to change how events update room activity or reply threads.

JetStream event publisher: per-slot-shard queues publish async in room order with Msg-Id = event id, route each event kind to its room, member or message subject, ensure CHATIM_EVT with its RePublish rule, and hand acked targets to the _state clear queue.
Test-only fake JetStream for publisher, sweeper and actor tests: records published messages and can hold, refuse or fail publishes by rule.
Read position coalescer: keeps the newest read per user and room for one window, then enqueues paged read_positions events per room on the publisher. Open it for MarkRead event batching.

The /app resync command: walks active rooms or one room in a time range, rebuilds the state targets of their current docs and re-flags their _state bits at a paced rate so the sweeper republishes the events; supports dry run.

Non-blocking queue that clears pending _state bits after a PubAck: batches targets so a room's consecutive seqs become one range write, never retries a failed clear (the sweeper republishes), drops and counts on overflow.

Pending-event sweeper run by the slot 0 owner: scans docs whose _state bits stay set past a minimum age, rebuilds their events per collection with a Rebuilder and republishes them, with checkpoints and pacing. Open it to add a sweep rebuilder for a new event.

Survival timers on CHATIM_TIMER: arm and disarm delayed checks of member, reaction and reply counts, and a shared consumer that runs the recount repair when a check fires. Open it for derived counter repair (design §7.1).

Interaction domain: Service for reactions, bookmarks, pins and unpins with access checks, count timers and events; Reader for bookmark, pin, reactor, reply and thread lists. Open it for reaction, bookmark, pin or reply-list behavior.
Pin projection shared by the pin fast path and the sweeper: folds pin facts onto the room's pin state and stores it with one CAS on the pin version, returning ErrContended on a lost CAS.

Member domain: Service for add, remove, leave, role, priority, read and unread, clear history and room preferences with request dedupe, owner rules and member count timers; Reader for member lists and room versions. Open it for membership or read position behavior.
Cross-node member cache invalidation: core NATS subscriptions on member_removed and member_role_changed subjects forget the room in the local member cache without decoding the payload.
Pure owner rules run inside the owner transaction: plans leave, remove and role changes that touch an owner and picks the successor owner, with no I/O or clock.

Message domain outside the send path: Editor for edit, delete, hide, forward and reply checks with access policy and events; Reader for history, messages by key, edit history and viewer-visible messages through the view pipeline.

Send path core: a Router with one actor goroutine per room assigns seqs, admits client ids through dedupe, writes each group once through the flusher, acks, enqueues events and commits the cid; uncertain writes return ErrRetryLater. Open it for SendMessage ordering or dedupe.
Sharded batching flusher: groups write groups from many rooms into one insertMany per shard and window, with a per-group deadline that fails unsent groups with ErrNotSent.
Reader pipeline applied to a page of messages: collapses retried duplicates, masks deleted content and turns cleared or hidden messages into placeholders for the viewer, without mutating input.
Permission hook: Checker enforces tenant and membership, then asks a Policy for the action; DefaultPolicy lets only the author edit or delete. Open it to change who may do what.

Chat domain types, validation and errors: rooms, members, messages, edits, reactions, pins, mentions, links, read positions, unread, room list sort keys and previews, and the shared sentinel errors such as ErrRetryLater.
Domain to protobuf mapping for responses and events, including the deterministic event ids of every event kind and the event payload builders. Open it to add an event kind or a proto field mapping.
Guard for Redis calls: per-call timeout, degraded mode with cooldown and a single probe, and once-per-episode logs; caller cancellation never counts as a failure.

Soft slot ownership on the state Redis: node heartbeat in the chat node table, lease claim, renew and release by Lua, batched ownership hooks and the Owns cutoff. Changes here need the R5 stress run (CLAUDE.md budget).
Test helpers: a counting slog Sink and SilenceRedis to mute go-redis dial noise in TestMain.

Room domain: Service for CreateRoom with founders and request dedupe, OpenDirectRoom with one room per user pair through room_dms, and UpdateRoom with events. Open it for room creation or room info changes.
RAM caches for the room list, for speed only: room info, room tails with previews, list snapshots and the chosen list path, plus a NATS watch that forgets rooms on change events.

Room list reads for ListMyRooms and GetRooms: orders a user's rooms by the joined or stepwise path, pages through snapshots, and fills unread counts and previews from fresh member data and cached room tails.

Storage ports and shared store rules: Messages, Rooms, members, edits, hidden, interactions, pins, reply threads, room list and tails, event states; key builders, cursors and input validation every adapter applies. Open it before changing any store method.
In-memory store adapter behaving like mongostore, used by unit tests of domains, events and transport; passes the storetest contract suites.

MongoDB store adapter: clustered collections with room-prefixed keys, codecs, bounded _id lookups, event state flags, owner transaction, room list reads, and Bootstrap with the index catalog. Open it for queries, indexes or document layout.

Contract suites every store adapter must pass (messages, edits, members, interactions, pins, counts, direct rooms, reply threads, room list, tails, event states); run by memstore and mongostore tests.

Whole-chat integration tests against real Mongo, Redis and NATS: start chat nodes with app.Run and drive them over gRPC across sends, edits, members, reactions, pins, mentions, room list, sweeper, resync, recount, indexes and shutdown. Skip unless CHATIM_IT_* is set.

Gateway HTTP handler serving the chatrpc.Request() commands over Connect (proto and JSON): CORS, bearer-token auth, revocation check, per-user and node limits, the per-user, IP and device limit on GetPartURLs with the client IP read from trusted proxies only, then one forward to chat. Open it to change request handling, error codes or gateway metrics.

Gateway wiring and lifecycle: loads the JWKS, opens the chat router on the Redis node table, runs the identity revocation sync, builds the api handler and the HTTP/1.1 + h2c server, admin probes, readiness and graceful drain. Open it to change startup, shutdown or dependencies.
Gateway config loaded from env vars with validation rules and a secret-safe log view. Open it to add or change a GW_* setting; the list of vars lives in docs/apps/gateway.md.

Fixed-window command limits shared by all gateway nodes in the shared Redis: one Lua call counts the user, user plus IP and user plus IP plus device tiers with keys that expire with their window; Redis errors let the call through and are counted.
Identity bridge binary; main.go only calls app.Main (serve, probe or a one-shot admin command). Open apps/identity/internal/app for wiring and docs/apps/identity.md for operations.

One-shot identity admin commands run as /app <command>: migrate, bootstrap, tenants, users, groups, trusted issuers and their keys, signing key rotation and JWKS export. Open it to add or change an operator command.

Identity HTTP handlers: public POST /v1/token (RFC 8693 exchange), the JWKS, the Connect directory (GetUsers, GetMyProfile) with CORS and limits, and the internal revocation list. Open it to change an endpoint, its request parsing or its metrics.

Identity wiring and lifecycle: opens the MongoDB store, key ring, trust verifier and reloader, directory mirror, token exchange, public and internal servers, metrics, readiness and shutdown; also dispatches admin commands. Open it to change startup, wiring or health.

Identity config loaded from env vars (Mongo connection, secrets, token, exchange, directory and just-in-time write settings) with validation and a log view that hides secrets. Open it to add a setting; the var list lives in docs/apps/identity.md.

In-memory user directory per replica: a Cache of user profiles loaded in pages under a slot lease and kept current by the store change stream (Mirror), plus profile and group input checks. Open it for directory reads, the mirror loop or name and avatar validation.

Token exchange use case: verifies the tenant-signed JWT, checks tenant and user state, writes the user mirror just in time from name and picture, and signs the short-lived chat token. Open it to change exchange rules, refusals or profile writes.

Request protection for the token endpoint: a per-IP token-bucket limiter in a bounded LRU and client IP extraction from a configured edge header. Open it to change exchange rate limiting or client IP rules.

Signing key ring: reloads signing keys from the store, opens the active key into a Signer, publishes the JWKS and verifies chat tokens it issued, keeping the last good set on errors. Open it for key selection, JWKS content or self-verification.

Ed25519 chat token primitives: key generation, sealing keys at rest with AES-GCM, the EdDSA token signer and claims, JWKS building and merging, and session id format. Open it to change token claims, key storage or the JWKS format.

Identity storage ports and types: tenants, users, groups, signing keys, revocations, trusted issuers and keys, profile writes, directory entries and the change stream. Open it to see what the store must offer before touching mongostore or a consumer.

MongoDB implementation of the identity store in database chatim_identity: schema and index migration, tenants, users, groups and members, trusted issuers, signing keys, revocations, batched just-in-time profile writes, slot leases and the change stream. Open it for any identity persistence change.

Verifies JWTs signed by a tenant's backend against the trusted issuers and public keys (EdDSA, ES256, RS256), with a reloadable snapshot and refusal reasons. Open it to change issuer trust, key parsing or JWT checks of the exchange.
WebSocket server binary; main.go only calls app.Main. Open apps/websocket/internal/app for wiring and docs/apps/websocket.md for env vars, ports and operations.

WebSocket node wiring and lifecycle: JWKS and revocation sync, chat router, command executor, interest table, session server, NATS feed, typing relay, presence, admin probes, supervision and the shutdown plan. Open it to change startup, stop order or dependencies.

WebSocket node config loaded from env vars with validation rules and a secret-safe log view. Open it to add or change a WS_* setting; the var list lives in docs/apps/websocket.md.

Room interest table of the WebSocket node: which local connections follow which rooms (loaded from chat per user), routing of events and WsPublish packets to them, typing signals, resync after a jump and per-user connection limits. Open it for fanout and room membership on the node.

Online presence of the WebSocket node: batches connection stamps as expiring keys in the presence Redis and answers presence queries with a short cache. Open it to change presence stamping, Redis access or presence answers.

WebSocket connection lifecycle on gws: upgrade on /ws, authentication and token refresh, revocation, heartbeats, per-connection limits and send queue, request dispatch, presence watch, room subscription and drain on shutdown. Open it for anything a single client connection does.

Typing relay of the WebSocket node: takes client typing frames, delivers them to room viewers on this node and relays them to other nodes over core NATS, with rate limits; no chat or storage involved. Open it to change typing behavior.
Buf v2 generation config: pinned remote plugins for Go, gRPC and Connect writing into pkg/pb with clean regeneration (make proto).

Thin MediaService transport: caller from chatrpc metadata, proto to upload calls and back; Disabled answers every call with media is disabled (FailedPrecondition).

S3 adapter of the media module on minio-go: start, complete and abort multipart uploads, sign part URLs with the public endpoint and a pinned Content-Length, head and delete objects, check both buckets; maps storage codes to fixed errors and counts calls by operation and result. Never creates buckets; no SDK retries.
Background bucket check that decides whether media is ready: checks at start and every interval with a bounded timeout, logs on change, never fails Start.
Port of the media_uploads store: insert an upload session, read it, and move its state by CAS on state and version.
In-memory media_uploads store for unit tests of the media module.
MongoDB media_uploads store: clustered string _id with zstd, bootstrap and index catalog, CAS state moves with server time ($$NOW); duplicate keys and lost CAS return ErrRetryLater.
Contract cases every media_uploads store must pass.

Upload use cases of the media module: start (plan parts, open the S3 session, write media_uploads, sign the first round), part URLs, complete with client ETags (NoSuchUpload falls back to Head; wrong size is deleted and aborted), abort; every call waits for ready storage and checks key ownership.

Public entry of the media module, the only package chat imports: config, dependencies, Prepare (media_uploads bootstrap), MediaService registration (or the disabled one), readiness watcher, client config, index catalog and probes. Bad config makes media not ready instead of failing.
Mention App config: defaults for unset fields, validation rules and the stop timeout. Open it to add or change a Mention App setting.

Durable mention consumer on the chat event stream: ensures the JetStream consumer, decodes message events into plans, writes mentions, resolves recipients and publishes notifications, then acks, naks or terms each delivery. Open it for the mention write and notify pipeline.

Mention App domain types: mention targets (user, group, @all), mention docs and write plans, user groups, taggable groups, room types and the chat read types the module consumes. Open it for the shapes every other mention package shares.
Per-tenant RAM cache of the taggable group catalog with a TTL and per-tenant singleflight. Open it for group catalog reads and invalidation after SetGroups.
MentionService gRPC handlers: ListMentions (direct and group mentions, read state, visibility checks, cursor paging), SetUserGroups, SetGroups and ListRoomGroups. Open it to change a mention API.

Mention notifications as WsPublish packets: ensures the CHATIM_WS stream, builds notified and retracted notices paged by recipients, gates stale or superseded events and publishes batches. Open it to change notification content, ids or publishing.

Turns one mention-bearing message event (created, edited, deleted) into the store write plan and the current and previous target sets, and diffs them into notify and retract sets. Open it to change how events map to mention writes.
Resolves who a mention notifies: room members for @user and @all, members of taggable groups for @group, choosing the cheaper side for small or large rooms. Open it to change recipient selection.

Set of group ids present in a room behind ListRoomGroups: builds it from room members and user groups, caches it, rebuilds large rooms in the background and forgets rooms on live member changes. Open it for the @group picker data.

Mention App storage ports (Mentions, Rooms, UserGroups, Groups), their query and cursor types, input validation and pure helpers that merge and page mention lists. Open it before changing an adapter or a mention read.
In-memory Mention App store adapters for unit tests; each passes the storetest contract suites.
MongoDB adapters of the Mention App ports over its four collections, plus bootstrap of clustered collections and the module index catalog. Open it for mention persistence, indexes or query plans.
Contract test suites every Mention App store adapter must pass. Open it to add a behavior both memstore and mongostore must honor.

Public entry of Mention App, the only package chat imports: config, dependencies, the ChatReader port chat fills in process, index catalog, lifecycle (Prepare, Run, Close), gRPC registration, live watch and probes. Open it when wiring Mention App into chat.

Token checks shared by websocket, gateway and identity: verifies EdDSA chat tokens against a JWKS, keeps the revocation list, and syncs the list and keys from identity with a shared copy in Redis. Open it to change token claims, revocation or how nodes follow identity.
Test fakes for pkg/auth sync: a valid dev SyncConfig and HTTP doers that accept or refuse every identity request. Tests only.

Calls into chat from websocket, gateway and tools: the Realtime/Request method split, a generic Forwarder that copies known fields and maps chat errors, slot routing to the owning chat node (or any live node) from the Redis node table, and caller metadata headers.
Private admin HTTP server of every app: liveness, readiness, pprof and an optional metrics handler on its own port, plus Probe used as the container healthcheck.
Transport-neutral error kinds returned by domain code and mapped to gRPC codes once at the server boundary. Use these instead of status errors inside apps and modules.
Jittered wait helpers for clients and followers (chat code itself never retries) and the websocket retry_later hint.
Typed environment variable parsing for app config; Secret reads NAME_FILE before NAME so secrets come from mounted files.
gRPC client factory with the shared service config: round robin, retries only for health checks, so a chat node failing mid-call surfaces as UNAVAILABLE after one attempt.

gRPC server for chat and Mention App: keepalive, health that turns off on drain, and the interceptor chain recovery, load shed, deadline, logging and error boundary; ToStatus maps apperr kinds to gRPC codes.
Shared CORS handler for public HTTPS APIs: exact listed origins only, no credentials, preflight answers; headers come from Config.
Generic JetStream pull-consumer parts: a pull source that never drops a delivered message at a client deadline, the Nak delay ladder by delivery count, and a rate-limited warning log.
Generic least-recently-used cache without its own lock (callers lock); Peek reads without refreshing order.
Pull-based Prometheus handler: each app lists Sources (counter, gauge or histogram read by function at scrape time) under its namespace and subsystem. Open it when adding a metric.

Builds bounded _id filters for clustered collections (never _id $in, D139): sorted, merged key runs as an $or of ranges with extra predicates inside each branch. Use it for every multi-key _id lookup.

Declared MongoDB indexes and their upgrade path: compares declared catalogs with listIndexes, builds missing ones, drops replaced ones only when the new index is ready, and reports outdated indexes as health. Backs the /app indexes command.
Secret scrubbing for logs and errors: masks URL userinfo and secret query values, replaces literal secrets, wraps errors keeping the chain, and a slog.Handler that scrubs every record.
Process-wide concurrency limiter for load shedding: bounded in-flight slots with a short queue wait, ErrOverloaded when full.
Per-node request limits for HTTPS services: a lock-free node-wide in-flight Gate and per tenant+user token buckets with an in-flight cap and bounded memory.
Identifier rules: random non-zero 63-bit room ids carried as decimal strings, and validation of tenant, user and cid that names the field without echoing input.

Big-endian _id encoding for clustered collections: messages, edits, pins, members, message_interactions and mentions, with parsers and range helpers. Open it before writing any _id range or key layout.
Go, gRPC and Connect code generated by buf from proto/ (chatim.v1 and chatim.identity.v1), never edited by hand; regenerate with make proto.
Slot math and chat node discovery: slot of a room, rendezvous preference, Redis key names, and a Resolver that maps slots to chat addresses from the node table and leases with a live-node fallback.

Contract of the websocket mailbox stream: subject grammar per tenant, name and kind validation, recipient paging with stable page ids, and the JetStream stream config. Open it when publishing WsPublish packets.
Small websocket client for tests, e2e and load tools only (D208; never an SDK): dials, authenticates, heartbeats, matches calls by id and queues server frames.
DirectoryService of identity: GetUsers and GetMyProfile served from the in-memory user mirror.
Core chat data and the room and message requests: Room, Message, MessageVersion, enums, and create, DM, send, history, edit, delete, hide, clear and edit-history messages.
ChatService definition: every chat RPC. Open it to see the full API surface.
Event envelope published on JetStream with its oneof payloads for message, room, reaction, pin, member and read changes. Read with docs/events.md.
Member and read-position messages: roles, add, remove, leave, role and priority changes, MarkRead/MarkUnread, and the member and read event payloads.
MentionService of Mention App: ListMentions, SetUserGroups, SetGroups and ListRoomGroups with their group messages.
Leaf link types used by Message and requests: reply and forward references, mention targets and sets, reply preview and count, mention groups.
Read API messages: GetMessages, ListThreads, GetReactions, ListPins and ListMembers.
Notification carried inside WsPublish packets on the websocket mailbox: mention notified and retracted payloads.

Requests and responses of SetBookmark, GetReplies, ListBookmarks and ListMentions.
Conversation list, room preferences and room info messages: ListMyRooms, GetRooms, ListMyRoomIDs, SetRoomPreferences, UpdateRoom and per-viewer room state.
